_comment: Q9-AF v3 CHEAP SENSITIVITY JOB (mode S, jobs/q9af_v3/README.md 'Cheap first job'): can ANY single attention layer of Qwen3.5-9B be converted to a (widened, dk 256) GDN with a small recall loss under the recall-heavy mix? Stage 1 of all 8 (15 min), then each layer ALONE: 10 min KD on 50% generic windows + 50% synthetic recall rows (no teacher generation: its 75 min is the big job's), recall probe (MQAR + NIAH, the v2 settings) + held-out KL. Capacity control: the 2 worst layers again at v2's width (dk 128). Mix: v2's clean recipe at 60M tokens (same sources, filter, shares, held-out).

distill._comment: recall-gated per-group conversion (convert.distill.conversion_plan, order ascending_recall): order = ascending single-layer recall damage (MQAR drop + NIAH drop after stage 1; ties: single-layer KL, then index), groups of 2, stage minutes = 60 + 280 x the added layers' damage share; every stage trains ALL converted GDNs on the mix_fracs stream; keep the best held-out-KL checkpoint per stage; after each stage the runner gates on recall + proxy600 (jobs/q9af_v3/rule.py stage_gate) and STOPS converting on a breach.

gdn._comment: converted layers only: nk 16 x dk 256 (= the attention head dim) x nv 32 x dv 128; native GDNs keep dk 128

recall_probe._comment: configs/q9af_v2_clean_h100.json probes (the v2 MQAR / NIAH drops)
